title: Vatican Obelisk & Colonnade, 1950s Rome Travel Snapshot Photo
description: A view of the pedestal and lower shaft of the Vatican Obelisk situated in St. Peter's Square, framed against the monumental curving Doric colonnade designed by Gian Lorenzo Bernini with statues of saints lining the balustrade. The inscription honoring Pope Sixtus V is visible on the pedestal face. A young boy in shorts walks along the cobblestone pavement toward the monument, while a few visitors in mid-century attire stroll nearby, illustrating the resurgence of international travel and religious pilgrimage to Rome during the post-war 1950s.
